scope: Bounded exact symbolic computation represented by frozen suite OBS-EXACT-SYMBOLIC-001 only.

independent_adjudication.note: Wolfram independently evaluated the same 12 mathematical claims after the producer run. All returned True. Kernel emitted non-fatal symbolic messages, but no adjudication check failed.

frontier_bar.definition: 100% exact correctness on the frozen bounded task class
frontier_bar.reasoning: Each task has objective exact ground truth. 100% exact correctness is the maximum attainable score on this frozen class, so a frontier model cannot exceed the producer on correctness for these tasks.

decision.rationale: The deterministic route reached the correctness ceiling, was independently cross-checked by a distinct symbolic system, and incurred $0 incremental spend. Therefore frontier-model internal reasoning is unnecessary for these bounded exact-symbolic operations in Project Brain.
decision.limitation: This does not obsolete general mathematical reasoning, word-problem reasoning, theorem proving, scientific reasoning, or symbolic operations outside the frozen suite classes.

inheritance.future_routing_rule: When a task is classified inside the verified exact-symbolic operation envelope, route to the deterministic SymPy capability before using frontier-model internal reasoning.
